title: Change
description: One entry of a run's change log: one line of changes.jsonl.gz. Entries are sorted by program, then kind, then scope and target.

sequence.description: The bundle sequence that made the change.

kind.description: program_dropped: the program is no longer in the feed (closed for more than 180 days); every other kind names a program present in the same bundle.

target.description: Target changes only: the target after the change (before, for target_removed).

fields.description: For program_modified, rules_changed, status_changed and target_modified: the JSON fields that changed.
